summary: Note-inspect popup shipped in public/graph.html. Note keys in guidance question/context text and cluster member lists are now clickable (linkifyNoteKeys runs AFTER esc(); scan regex requires a digit in bare ids so prose like "note-taking" stays plain; openNotePopup re-validates vs ^note:note-[a-z0-9]+$ — no XSS path). Click opens a centered overlay modal (#noteOverlay z-90, DOM outside #guidance so the 2s signature-gated triage re-render never closes it): label, kind/status chip, summary, knowledge, validFrom/validTo, supersedes/supersededBy chain (superseded = strike-through title + red chip, chain keys clickable), raw key, and an "open in side panel →" link calling openDetail(). Closes via ✕ / Esc / backdrop; one popup at a time; per-session noteDetailCache keyed by full key; loading + inline fetch-error states. Data from GET /task/detail (same shape openDetail uses; note fields confirmed live). Verified: node --check OK on extracted app script; served /graph md5 == disk; regex matched all 6 note ids across the 2 live review questions; queue untouched (0 blocking / 2 review, same ids). Consolidate/Distinct/Answer/Copy-for-Claude untouched except memberRow's key span moved outside the radio <label> (so clicking it inspects instead of flipping the keeper pick).

subject: Triage UI: clickable note ids + in-page inspect popup
description: Follow-up to the guidance triage UI (#4): guidance rows mention note keys (e.g. "Notes: note:note-mq6w3gu1, note:note-mq70uwfo...") as plain text, so the user can't inspect what a note actually says before choosing Consolidate/Distinct. Make every note id appearing in guidance question/context text AND in the expandable member list clickable, opening a lightweight in-page modal popup (not navigation): note label, kind/status, summary/body, knowledge items, supersede chain info if present, fetched from GET /task/detail?key=note:<id> (cache per session). Esc / click-outside / ✕ closes; popup stacks above the guidance banner; include an "open in side panel" link that calls the existing openDetail(key) for the full panel. Match dashboard styling.
